name.zh: 与青梅竹马菲尔菲重逢

periods.summary: Lux joins the second-year class and reunites with his childhood friend Philuffy Aingram, who insists he call her by their childhood nickname.
periods.cause: Lisha and Relie push Lux into trial enrollment at the girls' academy.
periods.process: Regrie introduces Lux to the class, Philuffy recognizes him as '小路', and classmates warm up after seeing their intimate but innocent childhood dynamic.
periods.outcome: Lux gains a friendly anchor in class and later becomes Philuffy's accidental roommate.
periods.aftermath: Classmates become curious and friendly toward Lux, while Lisha and Philuffy begin competing for his attention.
periods.significance: Introduces Lux's old emotional connection to the Aingram family and hints at Philuffy's past relevance.
